goalSummary: Timeout fires at ~950s wall-clock despite 600s setting

facts.why: The specific outcome type distinguishing OS-level stalls from genuine timeouts must be named
The specific security tooling processes causing CPU starvation must be identified for diagnosis
Fix: host_stalled must be excluded from the retryable errors set to prevent wasteful retries
The circuit breaker threshold of three consecutive host_stalled outcomes must be documented
Fix: recovery protocol requires restarting at a single clean commit rather than resuming mid-run
